blocks.x:
Known as 'Cyberpunk 2077's' biggest fan, Angharad is a Welsh games writer who thrives in anything related to digital storytelling. If a video game explores the intricacies and horrors of womanhood, she is there.
Thanks to previous work at GAMINGbible, GameByte, The Loadout, Game Luster, Angharad has built a strong understanding of both the digital world and what fans want from it and is eager to share her thoughts and expertise with readers.

As the best-selling video game release of 2023, it is hard to believe that Hogwarts Legacy has any faults. However, if there is one thing that fans can agree on, it is the disappointing lack of post-game content. With Avalanche Software choosing to direct its attention straight to a sequel rather than potential DLC, fans have been left with a base single-player campaign and not much else. However, thanks to said fans, our time with Hogwarts Legacy is far from over.

That is because its modding community has been working tirelessly over the past three years to bring new and exciting content to Hogwarts Legacy, with the majority of it being completely free to download and enjoy. From simple cosmetic updates to all-out quest lines, dungeons, and even multiplayer modes, this community is the sole reason why Hogwarts Legacy continues to flourish to this day, and this brand-new release is no exception.

Created by maxshig_dev over on Curse Forge, World Weaver is a mod unlike any other for Hogwarts Legacy, allowing players to "completely change the world to make it look how you want it to look." As such, every object in the world is now yours to control and place. "Along with placing new objects, you can edit the existing map to your liking. The best part is that everything saves!"
Want to build a castle in the mountains? You can!
Want to make a nice scene to take some pictures with your favorite character? Go for it!
Want to make a secret passage hideout in the walls of Hogwarts? Remove a wall and build it!

blocks.c: Image taken from the World Weaver Hogwarts Legacy mod

blocks.x: Quite literally introducing a build mode to Hogwarts Legacy, this ambitious mod has understandably been received well by players, going on to welcome almost 5,000 downloads since it was first uploaded earlier this year. Additionally, World Weaver has also continued to be worked on and updated, with its most recent update launching just six days ago.

With its developer planning on introducing triggerable objects that allow players to hit walls with spells to open passages or place custom interactive buttons to open doors, as well as even more objects, NPC and enemy spawning, and UI improvements, World Weaver is far from done, so there has never been a better time to download and share your feedback.

As one positive review reads, "Incredible mod so far. So much more than I expected. Experimenting with it right now, but it is already a delight," World Weaver is a Hogwarts Legacy mod that you have to try out for yourself, especially if you are a fan of its Photo Mode. Can you imagine the snapshots you could grab whilst being able to manipulate the environment? It would be magical.

text:
Hogwarts Legacy: World Weaver Update Is Available To Download Now, Thanks To Fans

Avalanche Studios

Published Sep 23, 2026, 7:00 AM EDT

Known as 'Cyberpunk 2077's' biggest fan, Angharad is a Welsh games writer who thrives in anything related to digital storytelling. If a video game explores the intricacies and horrors of womanhood, she is there.
Thanks to previous work at GAMINGbible, GameByte, The Loadout, Game Luster, Angharad has built a strong understanding of both the digital world and what fans want from it and is eager to share her thoughts and expertise with readers.

As the best-selling video game release of 2023, it is hard to believe that Hogwarts Legacy has any faults. However, if there is one thing that fans can agree on, it is the disappointing lack of post-game content. With Avalanche Software choosing to direct its attention straight to a sequel rather than potential DLC, fans have been left with a base single-player campaign and not much else. However, thanks to said fans, our time with Hogwarts Legacy is far from over.

That is because its modding community has been working tirelessly over the past three years to bring new and exciting content to Hogwarts Legacy, with the majority of it being completely free to download and enjoy. From simple cosmetic updates to all-out quest lines, dungeons, and even multiplayer modes, this community is the sole reason why Hogwarts Legacy continues to flourish to this day, and this brand-new release is no exception.

Created by maxshig_dev over on Curse Forge, World Weaver is a mod unlike any other for Hogwarts Legacy, allowing players to "completely change the world to make it look how you want it to look." As such, every object in the world is now yours to control and place. "Along with placing new objects, you can edit the existing map to your liking. The best part is that everything saves!"

Want to build a castle in the mountains? You can!

Want to make a nice scene to take some pictures with your favorite character? Go for it!

Want to make a secret passage hideout in the walls of Hogwarts? Remove a wall and build it!

Quite literally introducing a build mode to Hogwarts Legacy, this ambitious mod has understandably been received well by players, going on to welcome almost 5,000 downloads since it was first uploaded earlier this year. Additionally, World Weaver has also continued to be worked on and updated, with its most recent update launching just six days ago.

With its developer planning on introducing triggerable objects that allow players to hit walls with spells to open passages or place custom interactive buttons to open doors, as well as even more objects, NPC and enemy spawning, and UI improvements, World Weaver is far from done, so there has never been a better time to download and share your feedback.

As one positive review reads, "Incredible mod so far. So much more than I expected. Experimenting with it right now, but it is already a delight," World Weaver is a Hogwarts Legacy mod that you have to try out for yourself, especially if you are a fan of its Photo Mode. Can you imagine the snapshots you could grab whilst being able to manipulate the environment? It would be magical.
